source: LM8UU linear ball bearing, ISO 10285 / common catalogue dimensions 8 x 15 x 24 mm (plan.json datasheet note); retaining-ring groove spacing 17.5, width 1.1, diameter 14.3 mm from the standard LM8UU catalogue tables. Printing allowances are assumptions.
frame: bearing: axis along Z, origin at the centre of face A, face B at Z = width

housing_allowance.source: assumed FDM convention: printed housing bore = outer diameter + this for a light press; +/- 0.1, tune with a test ring

shaft_clearance.source: assumed FDM convention: smooth shaft is the bore size; printed shaft stub = bore diameter minus this for a slip fit; +/- 0.05

groove_spacing.source: ISO 10285 / LM8UU catalogue: distance between the retaining-ring grooves B

mount.notes: Pressed into a printed housing bore (HOUSING_BORE.diameter) at least `width` deep, seated against a shoulder or retained by a lip on one face; the shoulder must stay on the outer ring, i.e. outside bore_diameter + (outer_diameter - bore_diameter) / 4 radius clearance round the bore, so the inner ring turns free (assumed convention, not a datasheet value). The outer ring in its housing and the shaft in the bore are designed contact; nothing printed may enter bore_open except the shaft.

notes: d 8 (shaft size), D 15, L 24 per ISO 10285 / plan note; groove spacing 17.5, groove width 1.1, groove diameter 14.3 from common LM8UU catalogue tables (+/- 0.2, makers vary). Bearing axis is the shaft axis; the shaft runs through bore_open and beyond FACE_A/FACE_B. Housing: a bore of HOUSING_BORE diameter at least 24 mm long, or two lips; retain with the grooves via circlips or end lips, or cable ties through a pocket. Housing allowance 0.1 is an FDM convention, uncertain by about 0.1 mm per printer. The caller must keep a printed shaft guide out of bore_open: shafts are 8 mm rods.
